metadata.description: Added t.-p., engr. (v.1) 3d ed. Journal of the sieges carried on by the army under the Duke of Wellington, in Spain, between the years 1811 & 1814, with an account of the lines of Torres Vedras. Ed. by Lieut. Col: Harry Jones
metadata.notes: Due to the binding of this book, the margins are tight throughout the book and print goes into the gutter. Also, pages 384 and 385 are torn and parts of the pages are very difficult to read.
